title: PM Modi proposes free e-visas, maritime plan to deepen India-Asean ties
description:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has proposed a series of initiatives to strengthen India-ASEAN ties, including free e-visas for tourists from ASEAN countries, a long-term maritime cooperation plan, nuclear energy technical exchanges and collaboration in critical minerals.
The proposals were outlined in a Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) statement following the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit in Manila on Tuesday.
Among the key proposals is a long-term ASEAN-India Maritime Cooperation Plan covering connectivity, scientific research, disaster management, Coast Guard cooperation, maritime domain awareness and seafarers' security.
Modi also proposed a joint cyber forensics training programme to build capacity in the region and ASEAN-India technical exchanges in nuclear energy.
Other proposals include an ASEAN-India Space Hackathon and cooperation in mining and critical minerals.
